Select dry, high-wind ("fire-weather") hours

Source: R/wind.R
fire_wind_hours.Rd

Keeps hours with gusts at or above min_gust_ms (default: the gust_quantile of the whole record) and relative humidity at or below max_rh. These are the conditions under which a tree blown into the line can start a fire that spreads.

Usage

fire_wind_hours(wind, gust_quantile = 0.95, min_gust_ms = NULL, max_rh = 30)

Arguments

wind

Output of wind_history() or nws_forecast().

gust_quantile

Quantile of the record used as the gust threshold when min_gust_ms is NULL.

min_gust_ms

Absolute gust threshold (m/s); overrides the quantile.

max_rh

Maximum relative humidity (percent); Inf keeps all.

Value

The selected rows, with attributes min_gust_ms, max_rh and n_record (hours in the full record).
